classification_reason: Setup, validation, the warning gate, status and view generation all worked first time with no change to any canonical file. But the documented fast test suite reports 18 failures that a user cannot act on (tests coupled to the maintainer's data), and it silently writes 135 trace spans into the learner's live operation log, making `los operations` report dozens of fabricated AMBIGUOUS writes.

consumer.goal: Confirm the tooling runs on this machine and the repository is healthy without changing notes
consumer.first_action: cat AGENTS.md → system/OPERATOR.md → README.md (Quick start, Commands)
confusions: make check first reported HYGIENE-VIEWS 'generated/ views absent' although EVAL-WORLD.json says generate ran; generated/ held only reports/validation-report.md
validate prints 3 warnings but warning_baseline says '0 warning(s) across 0 signature(s)'; OPERATOR.md explains exempt clock-derived advisories, so resolved by reading
test-fast is described as not loading repository state yet its failures are FileNotFoundError on the owner's workspace files
corrective_steps: ran make views to clear HYGIENE-VIEWS (derived only)
consumer.outcome: Tooling works: .venv on Python 3.14.4, hooks installed, validation 0 errors / 2 warnings (both WS-NEGLECT clock advisories), warning gate OK, views built. Fast tests: 18 failures tied to the maintainer's own data, not the learner's. No notes changed. Side effect the learner would not expect: the operation log now shows 45 bogus 'needs attention' operations from the test run.
